DeltaAI is operated by NCSA · University of Illinois in United States. This profile covers the documented compute inventory.

Scope and uncertainty

152 compute nodes: 132 NSF/NAIRR-funded and 20 Illinois Computes-funded. Four Grace-Hopper superchips per node.
